steps.hint: TARGET is the upright panel on your left. Look or point at it for one second; locating finds a control before you use it.
Look at TARGET and tap, or point and pinch or click. Selecting chooses a panel; its frame glows while you aim at it.
START is the round button in the middle of the desk. The cap sinks and lights up while it is pressed.
TOOL is on the left of the desk. Look at it and tap, make a fist, or hold the mouse button to pick it up.

steps.instruction: Release the TOOL away from the TOOL BAY.
steps.hint: Tap again, open your hand or let go over the empty desk, not the TOOL BAY tray. A released item stays where you leave it.

steps.instruction: Place the TOOL in the TOOL BAY.
steps.hint: TOOL BAY is the tray on the right of the desk. Pick up the TOOL again, then release it above the tray; it snaps in.
